case.summary: The analyst's suspicion is confirmed: both online purchases on C13487-K1 come from a Samsung SM-G935F / Android 7.0 / Chrome 62 profile behind an anonymous proxy that 27 other cards also used in November-December, 19 of them before this case opened, and that four August-September closed cases already marked as an undocumented fraud ring. The card's own history is in-person only. Verdict fraud at 0.90 on two independent families (device ring, prior undocumented cases); exposure $187.33 on this card. Block the card (L1), file a report (L2) under R6/R9/3a, monitor the 27 connected cards and escalate under R9; no customer verification is needed because the stop rule is met.

sar.narrative: This report concerns internal case AC-HHG-014 (alert HHG-014). Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22, card C13487-K1 held by customer C13487 was used for two online purchases of $112.37 (transaction 3460634, 2016-11-15) and $74.96 (transaction 3478561, 2016-11-22), both under product code C. Both purchases originated from a device profile recorded as SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080, marked as new for this account, connecting through an anonymous proxy. The cardholder's prior history consists exclusively of in-person purchases in billing regions 191.0 and 272.0 between $31 and $171, with no online activity before these two transactions. The same device profile was used by 27 other cards between 2016-11-01 and 2016-12-31, 19 of them before this case opened, in the same manner: small product-C online purchases, each marked new for the card, each behind an anonymous proxy. Four closed investigations from August and September 2016 (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035) confirmed fraud on the same device profile and were reported at the time, each naming 23 connected cards of that earlier wave. The pattern of one anonymised device making first-time online purchases across dozens of unrelated cards is consistent with a coordinated card-not-present ring operating stolen card numbers through a shared proxy, which matches none of the bank's five documented patterns. No prior report exists on card C13487-K1 and the customer name screened clear against the OFAC SDN list. Total unauthorised amount on this card is $187.33; the card is recommended for block and reissue, the 27 connected cards are placed under monitoring, and the case is escalated to a fraud analyst.
